findings.quote: The liquid pushed out of the left arm has nowhere to go except into the right arm, and both arms are the same width.
findings.note: "has nowhere to go" is a colloquial phrase that gives the liquid intent; the brief asks for literal textbook English in every reader-facing string.
findings.fix: The liquid displaced from the left arm moves into the right arm, and the two arms have the same cross-sectional area, so the fall on the left equals the rise on the right.

notes: Independent solve: left liquid surface falls 15 cm, right rises 15 cm, so the liquid levels differ by 30 cm. Pressure balance at the oil–liquid interface gives H_oil = (1.2/0.9) × 30 = 40 cm. Oil top sits at −15 + 40 = +25 cm and the right liquid surface at +15 cm, a difference of 10 cm. All printed equations follow correctly.
